author: [NAME]
body: Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Investing Made Effortless Groww has completely transformed the way I manage my investments. The user interface is incredibly clean, intuitive, and clutter-free, making it perfect for both beginners and seasoned investors. Setting up an account takes just a few minutes with their seamless paperless onboarding. What I love most is the absolute transparency—there are zero hidden charges, and investing in direct mutual funds is completely free.
